messages:
Maya R: kicking off a 0.8% canary for redwood-embed-v1q2 on /chat-stream. focus slices: long-docs, code-blocks, and entropy-sensitive prompts. keep an eye on behavior signals.
Owen L: noted. what's the experiment config? any special gates?
Maya R: baseline -> v1q2 (4bit hybrid). default auto-fallback active but adding a temporary behavioural_watchdog: dedupe_inc abs>0.9% OR entropy_shift > 1.5 bits OR semantic_cos_drop > 1.0% OR p99_lat_delta >170ms -> rollback. also soft-sum: length_std_rel*0.5 + rouge_drop*0.8 + small_repeat*1.0 >=1.0 -> fallback.
Devon H: can we also add an A/B check for semantic drift using embed pairs? run 500 live A/B pairs and compute mean cosine delta; if >0.9% abs -> alert.
qa-bot: preflight-check: replay harness loaded (samples=1500), prefix-consistency test enabled, embed-check unit tests queued.
rollout-bot: canary redwood-embed-v1q2 started at 1751238888 route=["/chat-stream"] size=0.8% policy=gradual
Maya R: starting shadowing @5% for 3h and a replay of last 2k messages. will attach diffs.
Owen L: small ask: ensure tokenization trace is captured for any mismatched outputs; previous quant variants showed one-off token merges causing low-level semantic shifts.
Devon H: also collect KV-cache hit stats; some hybrid quant paths change cache key framing which can mask apparent dedupe issues.
qa-bot: replay-job: replay-1751238888 started samples=2000 expected~9m
qa-bot: replay-job: replay-1751238888 completed. summary: overall dedupe_inc=0.45% abs, long-docs_slice dedupe_inc=1.05% abs, entropy_shift_longdocs=1.7 bits, embed_cos_drop_longdocs=1.15% abs, p99_lat_delta=140ms
Maya R: long-docs exceeded behavioural hard thresholds on entropy and embed_cos_drop. this would trigger rollback per temp config.
Owen L: thanks. check diffs for examples where entropy increased but rouge stayed similar  could be verbosity not quality loss. but embed drop suggests semantic drift.
Devon H: pulling example diffs now. found repeated trailing clauses and a few truncated code fences. tokenization trace shows EOS moved earlier in ~0.6% of long contexts.
Maya R: given embed drop + entropy shift + dedupe in long-docs, i'm going to rollback on /chat-stream. also tagging runtime for tokenization/kv-cache key investigation.
rollout-bot: rollback executed for redwood-embed-v1q2 on /chat-stream at 1751239020 by @Maya R
Owen L: follow-ups: 1) add behavioural_watchdog to default rollout config for streams and docs, 2) include embed-based A/B gate (500 pairs), 3) CI preflight to compare prefix hashes and tokenized-length histograms, 4) add small staged shadow step (5% for 24h) before any re-onboard.
Maya R: i'll open RFC + PR with new gate config and attach replay artifacts. will also propose adjusting the soft-sum weights by slice impact.
Devon H: created RUNTIME ticket and attached token traces + kv-cache metrics. assigning to @Owen L and @infra-quant for kernel review.
Maya R: thanks everyone. moral: behavioural signals (entropy/semantic) caught a subtle drift that perf numbers alone didn't show. we'll tighten the guardset for doc-heavy routes.
